svg.title: One download, two paths
svg.desc: The upper time series shows all forty raw one-second bins of aggregate application download throughput, including startup. The dashed horizontal line is the configured 200 Mbps capacity of one link; it is a setting reference, not a separately measured TCP throughput series. The blue transfer combines the QUIC and TCP paths, and the TCP path remains configured at 200 Mbps while the QUIC link is shaped. The shaded QUIC command window spans 15.44–25.66 seconds. The shaded UDP block runs between recorded transition points at 31.05 and 33.63 seconds. The lower panel plots all eighty successful concurrent echo replies; their measured p95 is 326.5 ms. Whole-transfer aggregate download average: 267.7 Mbps. Measured build: MPTUNNEL 0.6.0, source 1e8abedf.
